facebook.caption: Tourists walk straight past this. Hung Quoc Tu Pagoda sits quietly on Nguyễn Trung Trực while most visitors head to the beach. Dragon details on every surface. Incense smoke drifting through open courtyards. Zero tour groups. Phu Quoc has a slower side and this is it. 4.5 stars from the people who actually stopped. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Step inside Hung Quoc Tu Pagoda and the beach noise disappears. Carved dragons, burning incense, empty courtyards. This is the Phu Quoc most people never see.
